responsibility: Implements the Euler-tour forest data structure used by GCC for dynamic tree queries in dominance maintenance. It manages `et_node` objects and their splay-tree occurrences, supports linking and splitting tree edges, nearest-common-ancestor queries, ancestor checks, and root discovery, maintains depth/minimum metadata needed for those operations, and includes selftests for the dynamic-tree primitives that higher-level dominance code uses to answer fast dominance-tree queries and updates.
same_name_distinction: Provides the concrete Euler-tour forest implementation—splay-tree occurrences, link/split, NCA, ancestry queries, and selftests—that higher-level code such as dominance.cc relies on; et-forest.h only declares the low-level API and node layout.
